component.name: Omikuji
component.summary: Qt/QML based game launcher for Linux

description.p: A Qt/QML based games/apps launcher for Linux. Built 'cause I couldn't bear having 3 different launchers for just games.

SGDB 512x512 icon art priority + fallback and temp refetch
'-Latest' runner builds system
Release filter and build priority for runner sources
'Run alongside' field for games
'Check for updates on app launch' now for gacha games
Art preview button in game settings
ProtonDB lookup button for Epic and GOG games
New Documentation site with a full usage guide
Fixed the zoom shortcuts
proper fade and chevrons on scrollable items
error chip with scroll grab
system notification on completed download toggle
url regex and registry exe lookup for community scripts
ofuda's page restyle
proper m3 style checkboxes
epic and gog dlc installation flow
run --notify-gui cli flag or cross-process run state (updates, errors, etc.)
settings migrations and layout adjustements (from ui.toml -> app.toml)
settings page UI adjustement
downloads bandwidth limit and various params
Yostar gacha integration (Arknights (Global, KR, JP))
Library categories' context menu and drag function
Console mode pause shader when not focused

Added run wine commands dialog along other winetools

Added 3-mode (Normal, Fit, Frameless) game cards style

nvapi injection following source kind

GOG uninstall button

Ofuda system (prefix manager)

RPM packaging CI.
